entry_points.text: Unbind control maps user naming to a registered event device and releases the addressed processor or broadcast slot, with fast attempt under list protection and slower mutex-protected retry on contention, returning input size on success.

Clockevents sysfs bringup registers the subsystem then creates per-processor devices by processor number with current and unbind controls plus a broadcast device with current control, aborting on first failure; broadcast bringup may compile to inert success.

Self-test lifecycle creates a named thread at init, then registers, runs the suite in two locality modes, deregisters, and either terminates or idles for modular builds, with cleanup requesting termination when present. Async reassessment after instability runs via a work item that only launches a transient thread for final selection.

exports.text: Sysfs name intake rejects empty and overlong input, strips one trailing newline, copies normalized bytes with termination, and returns original length.

Clocksource removal is mutex-serialized and idempotent for detached instances. Marking unstable is idempotent, clears high-resolution and watchdog eligibility, zeroes rating when unregistered, and triggers async reselection after boot.

Timekeeping notify is idempotent when the requested source is active; otherwise accelerated reads converge to the final source capability, tick handling observes the change, and status reports landed or not. Fast raw reads retry a latch of base plus live offset; inline toggles are no-ops without build support.

Timer arming needs initialized non-pending timers with pinned local or global placement, deferrable diverted when supported. Modify may skip wheel movement on identical expiry or same bucket; reduce-only never moves later; cross-base moves use a migrating marker and are forbidden while running.

Cancel reports prior pending state, leaves idle untouched, and under shutdown clears the callback under lock to forbid rearm. Sync cancel detaches non-running timers or waits then retries, with on-stack release; one build defines waiting as no-op with sync provided elsewhere.

Sleep offers millisecond and tick blocking in interruptible and uninterruptible forms until expiry or interruption. Infinite timeout only schedules, negative is diagnosed with zero remaining, and finite reports clamped remainder.

hazards.text: Timer hazards are duplicate queueing, wrong-base locking during migration, rearm across shutdown, early firing from level truncation, and re-arming pending timers via simple arm warned once and ignored; mitigated by pending checks, migrating spin with revalidation, lock-protected callback clearing with mandatory locking on shutdown, outward bucket rounding, and modification ops for pending timers.
Unbind lifetime relies on the outer mutex keeping the found device valid after the inner list lock drops and across slow retry; early mutex release would expose use-after-free.

Selection finalization needs a rendezvous forbidden from workqueue context due to hotplug ordering; attempting it there would deadlock, so a separate thread is used with missed launches recovered by later scans.
Sync deletion in hard interrupt context is safe only for interrupt-safe timers; on real-time preemptible builds ordinary timers also need preemption enabled due to sleeping wait, else deadlock risk.

invariants.text: Best selection requires boot done, non-empty order, no test sources, optional current exclusion, and high-res-only during one-shot ticks, picking highest rating; a non-empty override matching a listed non-test source supersedes rating subject to tick compatibility, with proven-incompatible unstable discarded and unverified incompatible deferred. List stays non-increasing rating with splice at first lower rating. State lives in file-scoped current, suspend, watchdog, timer, boot, suspend stamp, running and reset count with mutex and spin serialization.

Suspend candidacy needs nonstop across suspend with warning when the candidate also supplies suspend callbacks, prefers highest rating, and may stay empty. Without watchdog build support, watchdog queries report absence and selection, dequeue and locking are inert, suspend stays pointer comparison, and current fallback uses generic selection in replacement mode.

Watchdog candidacy needs continuous operation without self-verification, excludes the incumbent during fallback search, and prefers highest rating. The supervision timer exists only while watched sources remain, starting pinned on the boot processor on first arrival and stopping on last departure, with markings cleared on identity change.

Masked cycle differences beyond a caller bound count as zero to avoid backward steps. Conversions within the advertised cycle limit use standard scaling and larger ones a wider safe path from the same bounded delta. Multiplier and shift maximize accuracy under a worst-case interval from caller seconds and rates, preferring larger fitting shifts.

Wheel placement partitions expiry distance into geometrically spaced levels, rounds outward so expiry never precedes request, sends past expiries to the current slot, and clamps distant ones to capacity. Insertion records occupancy and bucket position, advances the horizon when the bucket precedes it, marks pending, clears recompute, and evaluates remote wake. Wakeups are suppressed without tickless activity or for deferrable timers, otherwise only idle bases wake with pinned or full-tickless expectation. Base clocks move monotonically bounded by tick count and next horizon, refusing to pass an inconsistent horizon behind the clock.
Detachment unlinks bucket membership, clears occupancy only for the final member while requesting horizon recomputation, and poisons linkage; pending state is optionally cleared.

Sequence wait ends on peer error, local budget expiry, or reaching the cap, with only below-cap sequences counting as handover. First error wins under a global raw lock with scoped acquisition; later setters advance sequencing without overwriting. Dispatched check liveness is probed via the call descriptor lock marker without acquisition.

Sampling succeeds on matching expected flags before budget expiry without stop request; unexpected unstable or high-res markers fail fast, missing expected markers at exhaustion fail by timeout unless none was expected. Suite needs sequential acceptance of clean expecting high-res readiness, delay expecting no marker, and positive plus negative expecting instability. Skew sampling refreshes interval and count at most once per quarter second of raw time; global skew alternates zero and downshifted interval across periods, remote-only returns zero on the watchdog processor and fixed one millisecond elsewhere. Reset unregisters prior test source, installs base mode with optional remote decoration, clears history, restores low rating and flags with optional per-processor mark, and re-registers at nominal one million kilohertz rate.

Timer debug and tickless probes compile to tracker and branch checks or inert no-ops by build, covering activation, deactivation, init assertion and cancel tracing. Clocksource and watchdog-test diagnostics share module-name prefixes.

locks.text: Unbind holds a sleepable mutex for the whole operation to stabilize the located device, taking an irq-safe raw list lock only for name lookup and dropping it before blocking release.

Detachment attempts active-role handoff before removal, refusing busy when watchdog or current cannot move while tolerating missing suspend replacement; watchdog list removal uses irq-safe spin protection with outer membership mutex-protected, and unstable marking with watchdog linkage is atomic under a dedicated irq-saving spinlock.

Watchdog selection runs atomically under irq-safe protection, retaining the prior watchdog when no candidate qualifies or fallback finds none, and resetting markings plus ensuring timer activity on identity change.

Base resolution honors pinning for local versus global choice and diverts deferrable timers when supported; cross-base moves are marked migrating so concurrent acquirers spin and revalidate flags instead of locking the wrong base.

Ordinary timer completion waiting coordinates with expiry via a waiter count and a bottom-half exclusion lock held across callbacks, letting the waiter observe termination without blocking further expiries.

state_machines.text: Test injector offers quiet, delayed, forward-skewed and backward-skewed bases with an independent high bit for remote-only perturbation, decoded by masking the high bit; delay stalls about half a millisecond and returns unskewed time.
Timers move among idle, queued, migrating and shutdown, where migrating blocks base acquisition and shutdown is absent callback with queueing refused; transitions occur under base lock.

Skew assessment alternates publishing and validating phases synced by monotonic sequence increments, each side publishing locally before observing remotely; oversized masked delta or budget expiry drives a terminal failure.

structs.text: Broadcast pseudo device is statically defined with fixed broadcast name, zero identity, and clockevents subsystem membership. Watchdog test source is statically defined with fixed test name, rating ten, full 64-bit range, prelinked linkage, and flags joining continuity, calibration, mandatory verification and test participation.

Per-CPU coordination colocates call control first for alignment, progress, outcome, dual timestamps, source reference, isolated sequence counter and timeout budget. Global exchange combines exclusion with outcome, progress, separate reference and tested accumulations, dual timestamps and driver CPU identity, cache-line isolated. Outcomes separate success from frequency failures covering absent reference, readout timeout, reset need and skew, and coordination failures covering peer timeout and skew.

Supervision uses a half-tick period with fifty microsecond readout and default remote-wait ceilings; remote budget grows with interconnect distance from a per-distance quantum capped at five hundred microseconds. Tolerance shifts eleven and eight encode tighter versus looser allowances, test skew uses downshift eight for about four thousand parts per million, validation is bounded by three frequency retries and a ten-step sequence cap that doubles as wait sentinel, and remote-only test injection uses value two hundred fifty six in a high bit.
